title: K&H Visor Begone
description: This resource pack removes the visor overlay from Knights and Heraldry!
body:
**This texture pack will remove the overlay added by Knights and Heraldry's helmets, allowing players to see more freely without needing to wear worse armor!**

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/26b8b45426ce7752fb5302ef942e2e89f838180e.png)


```
Knights & Heraldry default texture
```


![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/227e6e4c007d64dc7b7e5ab4bd4bee20e09e4230.png)


```
Knights & Heraldry Visor Begone
```
